headline: Paraguay Prosecutor Seeks Detention for Ueno Bank Founder as Political Crisis Grows
summary: Paraguayan prosecutors requested preventive prison for the founder of the intervened Ueno Bank following deposit freezes, while political fallout prompted threats of impeachment against President Santiago Peña.
why: Ueno Bank's intervention and subsequent restrictions on millions of depositors triggered widespread financial panic and political instability in Paraguay.

impacts.name: Ueno Bank
impacts.why: The bank was intervened by regulators, its founder faced a detention request, and depositors lost access to funds.
